derivedTask.title: Transfer - Minimal URDF Package
derivedTask.goal: Convert a Three.js pallet-sorter scene into a minimal URDF plus deterministic per-link OBJ meshes.
derivedTask.skillBenefitRationale: The task depends on treating named groups as links, preserving nearest-named-ancestor ownership, exporting per-link OBJ files, and building a minimal URDF articulation graph.
